claim: Constructed genuine reciprocal Schwarz extension from modulus limits and a bounded nonzero collar, with unit boundary values derived rather than assumed; no Riemann port dependency.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Glue the two ORIGINAL bounded holomorphic functions across a real seam.
obligations.constructed_input: The conclusion is a single holomorphic function on the whole open rectangle agreeing exactly with the upper original function throughout its upper rectangle and the lower original function throughout its lower rectangle.
obligations.justification: The conclusion is a single holomorphic function on the whole open rectangle agreeing exactly with the upper original function throughout its upper rectangle and the lower original function throughout its lower rectangle.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.required_input: Cover the whole open seam rather than finite samples.
obligations.constructed_input: Every compact subsegment uses one uniform collar. Each seam point is compared to the same midpoint using its actual min/max subsegment, producing one additive constant across the entire seam.
obligations.justification: Every compact subsegment uses one uniform collar. Each seam point is compared to the same midpoint using its actual min/max subsegment, producing one additive constant across the entire seam.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.required_input: Do not assume the functions have complex boundary values.
obligations.constructed_input: Only bounded holomorphy on each open side and vanishing of the actual paired upper/lower jump in original relative neighborhoods are supplied. Neither original function is assumed continuous at the seam.
obligations.justification: Only bounded holomorphy on each open side and vanishing of the actual paired upper/lower jump in original relative neighborhoods are supplied. Neither original function is assumed continuous at the seam.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.required_input: Keep actual derivatives and original reflected evaluation.
obligations.constructed_input: The upper/lower horizontal real derivatives are derived by complex composition and restriction to the real axis. The lower evaluation is exactly conjugation of the upper point, not a separate arbitrary approach.
obligations.justification: The upper/lower horizontal real derivatives are derived by complex composition and restriction to the real axis. The lower evaluation is exactly conjugation of the upper point, not a separate arbitrary approach.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.constructed_input: Wedge integrals construct the primitives of the original functions. Derivative bounds give Lipschitz control on the convex rectangles, complete-target uniform extension constructs closure values, and local equality preserves the original complex derivative.
obligations.justification: Wedge integrals construct the primitives of the original functions. Derivative bounds give Lipschitz control on the convex rectangles, complete-target uniform extension constructs closure values, and local equality preserves the original complex derivative.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.required_input: Construct trace matching before analytic gluing.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual closure continuity supplies approaching primitive limits. Compact uniform jump plus real mean value applies to the original approaching primitive differences; no derivative of a limiting boundary trace is assumed.
obligations.justification: Actual closure continuity supplies approaching primitive limits. Compact uniform jump plus real mean value applies to the original approaching primitive differences; no derivative of a limiting boundary trace is assumed.

obligations.name: Identity
obligations.required_input: Recover the original functions by differentiating the glued primitive.
obligations.constructed_input: After subtracting the constructed constant the primitive is continuous across the whole seam. The independently constructed rectangle Morera theorem proves it holomorphic there; its derivative is holomorphic and agrees exactly with each original side function by actual local derivative equality.
obligations.justification: After subtracting the constructed constant the primitive is continuous across the whole seam. The independently constructed rectangle Morera theorem proves it holomorphic there; its derivative is holomorphic and agrees exactly with each original side function by actual local derivative equality.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.required_input: Provide a genuine edge-extension analytic theorem, not the final arithmetic P1 identification.
obligations.constructed_input: This theorem is independent of the Riemann-mapping port. Applying it to the original geodesic charts requires constructing their bounded reciprocal-reflection collars. Actual arithmetic quotient descent, finite vertex extension and global holomorphic sphere comparison remain subsequent joins.
obligations.justification: This theorem is independent of the Riemann-mapping port. Applying it to the original geodesic charts requires constructing their bounded reciprocal-reflection collars. Actual arithmetic quotient descent, finite vertex extension and global holomorphic sphere comparison remain subsequent joins.

obligations.name: Boundary values
obligations.required_input: Construct reciprocal reflection from modulus limits, then derive its actual unit boundary values.
obligations.constructed_input: The lower function is holomorphic by genuine conjugate-conjugate differentiation and inversion on the nonzero collar. Its bound is two. Original modulus tends to one, hence the exact reciprocal jump tends to zero. The preceding gluing theorem constructs a holomorphic extension, and uniqueness of original approaching norm limits proves its boundary norm is one.
obligations.justification: The lower function is holomorphic by genuine conjugate-conjugate differentiation and inversion on the nonzero collar. Its bound is two. Original modulus tends to one, hence the exact reciprocal jump tends to zero. The preceding gluing theorem constructs a holomorphic extension, and uniqueness of original approaching norm limits proves its boundary norm is one.
